project_info.theme: Texture demonstration for Hung Yen turmeric face mask
project_info.color_palette: Sky Blue, Warm Skin Tones, Turmeric Gold, Amber Brown, White

main_subject.detail: A close-up beauty shot of a smiling woman holding an open jar of Cocoon Hung Yen turmeric face mask while showing a finger loaded with thick golden mask texture toward the camera.
main_subject.style: Soft natural skincare lifestyle photography, intimate texture-demo close-up, clean and friendly

composition_elements.text: Visible product text includes 'Mặt nạ nghệ Hưng Yên / Hung Yen turmeric face mask'.
items: Top Left: Out-of-focus smiling mouth and cheeks of the model against a blue-sky background.
Top Right: Raised index finger close to the lens with a mound of golden turmeric mask texture on the fingertip.
Bottom Left: The model's other hand gripping the glass jar from below with natural nails visible.
Bottom Right: Open jar rim and label side text, with creamy whipped mask texture heaped above the container opening.
Center/Background: Blue sleeveless ribbed top and soft sky backdrop creating a bright lifestyle feel.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Gentle skin glow, shallow depth of field, creamy product texture emphasis, airy cheerful mood

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality advertising poster for a skincare texture demonstration. Centerpiece is an open jar of Cocoon Hung Yen turmeric face mask held in one hand while the other hand points a fingertip loaded with thick golden mask cream toward the camera. Background is a bright blue-sky lifestyle scene with a smiling woman softly out of focus. Surrounding elements: visible jar label text 'Hung Yen turmeric face mask', creamy whipped product surface, natural nails, and a pale blue sleeveless top. Keep the finger-to-camera perspective, realistic cream texture, and soft friendly beauty mood. Technical style: high fidelity skincare lifestyle photography, soft natural daylight, gentle skin glow and shallow depth of field, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark, gloomy, blurry, flat 2d, low resolution, distorted text, messy typography, muted colors, black and white, ugly, deformed shapes, watermark, signature, cropped
